_doc: Persona keyword configuration for behavior-based persona scoring. Each keyword list maps behavioral signals to one of three persona types. Keywords use substring matching to handle Japanese inflections (e.g. 'ほうじ茶' matches 'ほうじ茶の', 'ほうじ茶ラテ').

purchaseSignals._doc: Maps Shopify product tags or category keywords to persona types. Used when scoring purchase events.
